briefing.headline: US-China chip export controls tighten as OpenAI and xAI race toward next frontier releases

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs pushing multimodal agents into production. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows around export controls and safety benchmarks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI began rolling out o4-preview with advanced reasoning. xAI deployed Grok-4 on expanded Memphis cluster. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus while DeepSeek-V3.5 closed the performance gap on key benchmarks. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 weights under new license.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC began volume production of 2nm AI chips for NVIDIA. Microsoft and Google announced joint 5GW data center expansion in Texas. CoreWeave raised additional infrastructure capital for H200 clusters.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls on advanced chips slow China's progress enough to maintain a 12-month Western lead through 2027?
